newsitem.title: USA: Green Oasis sets midwest waste oil effort.
newsitem.headline: Green Oasis sets midwest waste oil effort.

text.p: Green Oasis Environmental Inc said it had reached an exclusive agreement with RecOil Inc for the development of Illinois, Indiana and Michigan waste oil markets.

Under the terms of the agreement, RecOil will purchase a minimum of three Model 400 processing units annually at a price of $1.5 million per unit for the next three years, as well as pay Green Oasis an annual royalty of $0.04 per gallon of diesel fuel produced to retain its exclusive agreement.
These three states account for approximately 20 percent, or 260 million gallons, of the estimated 1.3 billion gallons of waste oil generated annually in the United States.

"This agreement not only insures the annual sale of at least three Model 400 processing units per year for gross minimum revenues of $4,500,000 for each of the next three years, but it will also generate incremental revenues through royalties of up to $346,000, which will increase to $692,000 in year two and $1,038,000 per year thereafter during the life of the agreement," Green Oasis said.
"In addition, we have retained the right of first refusal should RecOil Inc elect to sell a portion or all of its waste oil processing operation in the future.

"This dedicated sale of approximately 40 percent of the capacity of one manufacturing shift will generate solid earnings for Green Oasis while generating the cash flow to accelerate its growth rate," the company said.
